QUOTE: nothing declared → whole_repo_scope; "index_scope present but rejected → log WARNING, fall to whole-repo, reason says why"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a declared scope is used and a rejected one falls to whole-repo. But it also says "a present-but-broken index_scope is REFUSED" and that a bad declaration is "rejected rather than quietly widening to the whole repo". That contradicts the item's claim that every failure falls through to the whole repository.
